writeup.headline: NVIDIA rates Buy on exceptional growth, margins and net cash, held back by middling valuation and trend scores.
writeup.thesis: NVIDIA scores 77, a Buy, 3 points short of Strong Buy. Growth scores 100 on latest-quarter revenue growth of 105.8% year on year and TTM revenue growth of 83.4%, with growth sped up by 20.6 pp from the previous quarter. Quality (97) and balance sheet (98) are near the top, with a 74.7% gross margin, 65.2% operating margin, 41.9% FCF margin, diluted share count down 1.0% year on year, and net cash. Valuation scores only 55: in absolute terms the multiples are high (17.1x sales, 40.9x FCF, 26.2x EV/EBIT, FCF yield 2.5 pp below the 10-year Treasury yield), although it is cheap against its own history, with EV/EBIT cheaper than at every one of the last 61 month-ends. Trend and news risk both score 55, with the price 10.0% below its 52-week high and shares 6.7 pp behind QQQ over the last 126 trading days.
key_risks: High absolute valuation leaves little room for a slowdown in AI data center spending.
Competition from AMD's MI455X and customers such as OpenAI reportedly buying Google chips.
China export controls: Q3 guidance of $108.0 billion assumes no China Data Center compute revenue, and reported Chinese orders may go unfilled.
Weak relative price trend, with shares 5.9 pp behind SPY over the last 126 trading days and the price 3.0% below its 50-day average.
Open regulatory issues, including export-control debates and the older China antitrust finding.
what_would_change: A 3-point gain in the score, such as from a stronger trend or better news-risk score, would lift the rating to Strong Buy.
Q3 FY27 results beating the $108.0 billion revenue guide, with gross margin near 74.0%, would support the growth and quality scores.
A fall of more than 13 points, for example from sharply slowing growth or a further drop in trend and news scores, would cut the rating to Hold.
Adverse export-control rulings or loss of major customers to rival chips would hurt the news-risk and growth factors.
